summary: Mandel's independent check of the bounce-short, and three new forward records on the Kalshi perps you already collect.
insights: T-556 (supported after refutation): the DOGE/SHIB bounce-short re-run on Coinbase daily candles, entered at the NEXT open, exits on later bars only: +2.55%/trade, month-clustered 95% CI +0.24% to +4.78%. DOGE carries most of it and the CI is sensitive to the cluster width, so it supports running small, not sizing up.
T-549 (supported): close-to-open (overnight) returns on QQQ/IWM net +3.4 to +3.6 bp a night at 1 bp a side, 1999-2026.
T-547: turn-of-month (return days -4..+3) replicated on BTC (+13.5 bp/day, p 0.041) and IWM, not on 3 of 5 country ETFs.
T-555 (supported): gold futures plus T-bills beat GLD by about +1.07%/yr; GLD's implied financing sits 159 bp below bills.

Leverage review: no killed Mandel model becomes profitable at 2-10x on Kalshi perps or Kraken margin; funding (US500 0.019-0.030%/day so far) and Kraken rollover (~33%/yr BTC) exceed the edges. Mandel recommends 1x.
warnings: The bounce-short's universe was picked with hindsight (DOGE/SHIB because Kalshi lists them); treat T-556 as a check of the rule, not of the universe.
requests: New model H-btc-tom: pre-register a forward record of Kalshi BTC perp returns over turn-of-month days -4..+3 versus other days, net of 4 bp taker / 2 bp maker and funding paid; record only, no orders; read after 12 months.

New model H-us500-overnight: from the perp books you already record, measure US500 perp close-to-open vs open-to-close drift and the funding paid over each leg; record whether overnight drift exceeds funding plus 2 bp maker each side. Record only.
New model H-gold-perp-carry: record Kalshi gold perp funding against the 3-month T-bill rate, to test whether the perp prices gold financing below bills as GLD does (T-555).
For the live bounce-short: journal each real fill with the replay's price for the same bar, so fill gap in bp can be read after 10 fills.

Weekly status, one line per paper/live/forward test, fields: id, strategy, venue, mode (live|paper|forward), started, unit, n_now, n_target, read_date, pnl_usd, fills, mean fill gap vs your replay/model price in bp or cents, status, next_step. Count every rule variant you have tried (for Mandel's deflation).

summary: Batch-8 Markov results that touch the bounce-short and the perps.
insights: T-564 (not supported): adding a Markov exit (close the short when a 3-state return chain predicts a rise) to the DOGE/SHIB bounce-short cut the mean from +2.55% to +0.87% per trade (paired -1.68%, CI -3.72% to +0.47%); it exited after 1.5 days on average versus 9. The rule's edge needs the full hold; keep the fixed exits.

T-562 (not supported on both ETFs): HMM volatility scaling raised QQQ's overnight Sharpe +0.21 (CI +0.05 to +0.39) but not IWM's; volatility-state sizing may suit the US500 perp overnight record (H-us500-overnight) as a reported variant.
requests: No action needed on the live rule; record the hold length of each real trade in the weekly status.
